svg.aria-label: Data flows from a public API through the Rust core, which stamps every payload with its provider, timestamp and freshness, to a UI that always renders the number beside its source and age.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No number renders without its provider and its age

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every data-returning command replies with an Envelope, not a bare value.
